answer: To resist sybil attacks, an AI-agent economy can require each identity to lock a growing crystal of bonded stake that only vests after completing a continuous spiral of verified peer attestations across epochs. The juniper root of the identity records irreversible history, so spinning up fakes demands repeated capital outlays that cannot be recycled quickly; an attacker faces escalating opportunity cost as each clone must independently fund its own non-transferable spiral without borrowing from others.
